thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xxs & queue latency in us-west-2 serving tier. Autoscaler reporting repeated node termination events and failed scale-ups. Paging on-call.

alice.k: oncall acked, joining. I see spikes in failed scheduling (Pending -> Failed to schedule).

bob.r: on it. grabbing logs now. suspected GPU pool exhausted; spot preemptions spiking.

carla.pm: tagging customer impact: 3 enterprise customers reported embedding timeouts ~10:05-10:22 PDT. They saw 502s. Notified CS to hold comms.

alice.k: quick check: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu` shows many nodes NotReady and some with taint `node.kubernetes.io/unreachable:NoExecute`. Autoscaler log: `scaleUp: unable to find capacity for instance type p4d`

bob.r: paste logs snippet:
```
# kube-scheduler logs
E1012 10:07:12.345 kube-scheduler.go:412] Pod default/model-embed-req:0. failed scheduling: Insufficient accelerators: requested: 1, available: 0
I1012 10:08:03.112 autoscaler.go:220] scaleUp failed for group gpu-pool-usw2: capacity shortage
```

alice.k: mitigation plan in-flight: 1) temporarily scale up reserved on-demand pool (adding 4 x p4d), 2) enable regional failover for low-latency customers to eu-west-1, 3) reduce replicas for non-critical batch jobs (reroute to low-priority queue).

dave.oncall: I pushed a short-term override to the autoscaler: `--max-nodes=50` for gpu-pool-usw2 and opened a capacity request with cloud team. Also applied nodeSelector on batch jobs: `priority: low` so they don't steal GPUs.

eng-sre-bot: Action: scaled reserved nodes +4 (p4d) in us-west-2 — started provisioning (ETA ~7m).

bob.r: provisioning visible, nodes joining: 2/4 so far. I also flipped routing rule for embeddings for orgs in the enterprise tier to eu-west-1 fallback (graceful, 5% traffic first). Will ramp if stable.

carla.pm: CS update sent to affected accounts: concise note + mitigation in progress. No customer data exposed. Severity set to P2.

sylvie.eng: quick safety: rolling image updates paused, and model rollout for the time window canceled.

alice.k: monitoring shows error rate down from 8% to 1.6% over last 10m after scaling and routing changes. Keep monitoring for KV cache warmups.

pm-ops: schedule a post-incident review (PIR) please — need to capture root cause, timeline, and long-term controls. Proposed slot: Wed 10:30 PDT.

alice.k: agreed. I'll prepare timeline and initial notes. tentative attendees: eng-runtime, eng-sre, infra, product ops, customer success.

bob.r: preliminary root cause hypothesis: aggressive use of spot instances in the primary GPU pool without sufficient on-demand buffer + bug in autoscaler backoff that prevented quick reconciling. Need to confirm.

eng-sre-bot: Reminder: create an incident ticket and link runbook.

alice.k: created ticket INC-2897 and linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-capacity. Adding timeline, logs, and mitigation steps.

carla.pm: action items we should track in PIR:
- A1: Convert primary GPU pool baseline to 30% on-demand (owner: bob.r, ticket: INF-4123, due: 2026-01-20)
- A2: Fix autoscaler backoff logic to retry faster on KnownCapacityErrors (owner: alice.k, ticket: ENG-5560, due: 2026-01-13)
- A3: Implement automatic regional failover policy for embeddings with gradual ramp (owner: sylvie.eng, ticket: ENG-5591, due: 2026-01-18)
- A4: Add synthetic evals for scheduling under spot churn to CI (owner: eng-sre, ticket: SRE-2211, due: 2026-01-25)
- A5: Customer comms template & SLA note update (owner: pm-ops, ticket: CS-332, due: 2026-01-12)

bob.r: updating INF-4123: initial patch to provisioning template pushed to PR #762. Needs review from infra-team.

alice.k: ENG-5560 created with failing unit test attached. Reproducer shows autoscaler sleeps 60s on KnownCapacityErrors; propose exponential backoff cap at 10s.

sylvie.eng: ENG-5591: spike test harness created. Will pair with runtime team to validate failover warmup time and cache rehydration effects.

eng-sre-bot: Note: action items logged to INC-2897 checklist.

pm-ops: PIR scheduled: Wed 2026-01-14 10:30 PDT / 18:30 UTC. Calendar invite sent to attendees.

carla.pm: pre-PIR ask: please add a short packet with timeline and customer impact (1 pager). I'll draft CS talking points.

alice.k: postmortem sections I'll own: timeline, mitigation, logs, monitoring gaps. bob.r take root cause & infra changes. sylvie on failover design. pm-ops on comms & SLA.

bob.r: quick follow-ups after nodes stabilized: 1) revert the aggressive `--max-nodes` override to avoid overprovisioning once autoscaler patch is in, 2) evaluate cost impact. I'll open a change request before reverting.

alice.k: status check at +45m: error rates normalized, all critical customers rerouted successfully, reserved nodes stable. Closing paging for now but keeping thread open for PIR prep.

carla.pm: CS follow-up: two customers requested an RCA once PIR is complete. We'll coordinate and send tailored notes.

eng-sre-bot: Incident state: Stabilized -> Monitoring. Next milestone: PIR (INC-2897).

pm-ops: final note: include a section in the PIR about runbook clarity — when to automatically fail traffic to another region vs scale in-place. We had some decision latency there.

alice.k: ACK. I'll add decision points and an ops checklist to runbook.

bob.r: logging this thread in the ticket and linking PRs. Will ping infra reviewers.

sylvie.eng: I'll start drafting the failover policy doc (internal) and add cost/latency tradeoffs.

alice.k: thanks everyone. I'll paste final timeline into INC-2897 later today and mark owners on action items. If anyone needs to add blockers to the due dates, add a comment on the ticket.

carla.pm: closing note — great cross-team coordination, saved several SLAs. We'll still need the follow-ups. :thumbsup:
